answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with surprise audits. Each epoch a random 3% of identities get a fresh task and 90 seconds to solve it, then their pearl-sized reward share is held in a vault. A farm of 200 puppets runs out of compute and misses about 40% of audits, so each miss burns 25% of its vault. Honest agents pass nearly always. The lantern is random selection: nobody can predict who is checked.
